versions.content: A SF is sent when a message does not exceed the available amount of payload of this frame type or if ISO 15765-2 compliance is required. To be compliant with ISO 15765-2 on the one hand and to allow using the possibilities of FlexRay on the other hand, there are two types of Single Frames. In ISO 15765-2 compliant channels only SF-I is allowed, in non ISO 15765-2 compliant channels (i.e. FrArTpLm = FRARTP_L4G) only SF-E is allowed.
